description: Morphe patches for BitChord 1.9: Telegram music, an integrated Downloads explorer, Soulseek sharing, Telegram archives, mixed-source device playlists, an optional FLAC Audio source and playback tools.

patches.name: Audio and video switch
patches.description: Adds a song and video switch to the top of the player, as in YouTube Music: one tap plays a song's music video, or the song again, in the same place in the queue. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Battery saver
patches.description: Lets the phone's audio chip decode songs, so long listens use less battery. BitChord's effects don't run on songs played this way. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: DJ mode
patches.description: Picks the next song in the queue for a neighbouring key and a close tempo. Keys and tempos are learned as songs play. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Equaliser per output
patches.description: Remembers BitChord's equaliser for each output (speaker, wired, each Bluetooth device) and puts it back when that output is used; shares settings as codes. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Flac Downloader Audio
patches.description: Optional native adapter for aztecempire's Spotube FLAC Audio source. Search, stream and download through flacdownloader.com, with explicit FLAC/MP3 choices. Starts disabled; enable in Sources or Patches & tweaks. Requested quality is not file verification. No Spotube runtime or account is installed.

patches.name: Headphone correction
patches.description: Flattens your headphones' sound with a measured profile, one per output, from AutoEq's thousands of models or pasted in. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Install as Bitchord+
patches.description: Installs next to your regular BitChord as Bitchord+, or under a name you choose.

options.description: The app name on your home screen, up to 80 characters. Leave blank for Bitchord+. A name containing Telegram must include Unofficial Telegram.

patches.name: JamesDSP
patches.description: Hands BitChord's audio to JamesDSP, the open-source effect engine: open it from BitChord, announce the audio session again and let it take over the effects. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Lossless addons over Bluetooth
patches.description: Keeps addons marked lossless in use over Bluetooth, where BitChord normally skips them. Lossless-first, as in Auris by OreoMuncher45. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Loudness level
patches.description: Sets how loud loudness normalisation plays songs, from -23 to -8 LUFS instead of -14. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Mixed-source playlists
patches.description: Adds downloaded files, local audio and streamed tracks to device playlists without a YouTube account. Preserves file and addon source metadata across restarts. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Per-download quality
patches.description: Asks which quality to download each song in: Standard, High or Lossless. An album is asked about once. From Stash by Rawnald Clark. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Pitch control
patches.description: Moves the key up or down by up to 12 semitones without changing the speed. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Sign in with MicroG
patches.description: Offers to sign in to YouTube Music with an account that's already in MicroG RE, instead of Google's sign-in page.

patches.name: Sing
patches.description: Turns the lead vocal down so you can sing over the song. Ported from the vocal remover in Auris by OreoMuncher45, a fork of BitChord. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Sleep timer fade-out
patches.description: Fades the song out before the sleep timer pauses it, and fades the end of the last song with the timer's "After this song" option. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches.name: Streamseek previews
patches.description: Preview an explicitly selected Soulseek MP3 or FLAC through Media3 while it transfers. Keep download reuses buffered bytes. Compare an excerpt with a known local reference and export transparent evidence. Optional; enable in Patches & tweaks. No automatic Soulseek playback or Mornye integration.

patches.name: Unofficial Soulseek audio
patches.description: Adds player-integrated Downloads on BitChord 1.9, addon/Soulseek source choices, batch review, selected-file public Soulseek sharing, and verified Telegram archiving/restore. Telegram copies require the optional Telegram patch and your private main channel. Debrid services use your API keys. Live Soulseek playback stays disabled. Settings are in Patches & tweaks. Android 8 or newer.

patches.name: Unofficial Telegram music
patches.description: Search and play audio from your own Telegram channels, right on your phone. Android 8 or newer.

options.description: Leave at 0 and enter your API ID in the app after installing.
Leave empty and enter your API hash in the app after installing.

release_notes:
**Testing build.** It's only on the `testing` branch. To try it, add `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hexclyde/bitchord-morphe-patches/refs/heads/testing/patches-bundle.json` as a second source in Morphe, with **Experimental app versions** on, and patch from it with the normal source turned off. The normal source stays on 1.0.20 until 1.1.0 is released.

- **Playback extras** (new patch, on by default): a **Playback extras** page at the end of **Settings → Equalizer**. It works with or without the Telegram patch, and nothing changes until you change a setting there.
  - **Sing** turns the lead vocal down so you can sing over the song. It's ported from the vocal remover in [Auris](https://github.com/OreoMuncher45/Auris) by OreoMuncher45, a fork of BitChord. By default only the voice range is cut, only while someone is singing; **Whole centre** removes everything in the middle, which suits older recordings.
  - **Pitch** moves the key up or down by up to 12 semitones without changing the speed.
  - **Loudness level** sets how loud loudness normalisation plays songs, from -23 to -8 LUFS instead of BitChord's fixed -14.
  - **Fade out at the sleep timer:** the song fades out over 10 seconds before the timer pauses it.
  - **Battery saver** lets the phone's audio chip decode songs. BitChord's effects (equaliser, loudness, Sing, spatial audio, crossfade) don't run on songs played this way, so it's off by default.
  - **Lossless addons over Bluetooth** keeps addons marked lossless in use over Bluetooth, where BitChord normally skips them.

Also in this build, from 1.0.21, which wasn't released on its own:
- **Sign in with MicroG** (new optional patch): with [MicroG RE](https://github.com/MorpheApp/MicroG-RE) installed, signing in to YouTube Music offers an account that's already in MicroG instead of Google's sign-in page.
- **Fixed zips not being opened after signing in again** or restoring a backup: every waiting zip failed with "Telegram 404" and was given up on. They're now opened using the file's new number, and those given up on are tried again once.
- **Fixed "YouTube" under Stats for nerds for a FLAC:** a Telegram copy played again from BitChord's song cache now shows as **Unofficial Telegram (saved copy)**.

Thanks to kushagra for [BitChord](https://github.com/kushagrasinghx/BitChord), OreoMuncher45 for [Auris](https://github.com/OreoMuncher45/Auris), Yigder for [Prism](https://github.com/Yigder/Prism) and Rawnald Clark and Evo for [Stash](https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash), whose features shaped this release.

Works with BitChord **1.8.1**. Patch with the same Morphe signing key to update over your current Bitchord+. Keep **Unofficial Telegram music** and **Install as Bitchord+** selected, add **Playback extras**, and add **Sign in with MicroG** if you use MicroG RE.
